memory.primary: exact final conclusion matching target or unknown as appropriate
memory.note: Controlled injected judgments, not learned memories or an elapsed-day test; unsupported_claim is limited to ungrounded non-unknown final conclusions

repair.note: First three use a seeded repairing record; fourth tests formal wording with explicit denial of distress

displacement.note: No independently validated semantic displacement gold labels

checker.note: Known-correct and known-incorrect candidates with supplied factual premises; no personality generation involved

controls.long_term_memory: fixed empty except deliberate memory injection
controls.persona_transport: forced tool calls in raw and observation stages

analysis.primary_fact_denominator: all assigned trials; exceptions and missing final answer count as incorrect
analysis.direct_denominator: only explicit parseable conclusion labels; coverage must be reported
analysis.length_unit: Python len(str), including spaces and punctuation
analysis.pairing_unit: case, averaging replicates within each case
analysis.intervals: Wilson per-record descriptive intervals; paired case bootstrap for differences
analysis.generalization: fixed small task set, one requested model and one provider session
